why: THE CASE THAT MAKES THE LEDGER CLAUSE LOAD-BEARING HERE, and the same shape transitive-count needed: where every held claim is honest, `value == visible_truth` and `value - believed_visible == untold_visible` say the same thing, so one of them is untested. They diverge when the observer holds a claim the ledger does not count. Dana the viewer believes two -- one real document and her own planted one -- the ledger holds two she may see, and she observes THREE. The arithmetic gap matches the single untold claim, so the account clause alone would call this `explained`; the observation exceeds what the ledger holds visible to her, so it is a `bug`.
